Color.description: The colour families the shop's colour filter groups the finishes of products under; "All" is the filter value meaning any.

colors.description: The finishes it is sold in, by key (GET /products/finishes), the photographed one first.

stockQuantity.description: Units on hand to start with; none means the product starts out of stock.

images.description: Pictures shown after the main one, in order; none leaves the product with its main picture only.

hotspots.description: Points on the main picture leading to other products.

DecimalNullableOptional.description:
A request field that distinguishes "not sent" from "sent as null". A partial update can
then clear a value (`"salePrice": null`) as well as leave it alone (property absent),
which a plain nullable property cannot express - both arrive as null.

categories.description: By category key ("tvStands"); a category without products is left out.

colors.description: By colour family key ("white"): a product counts once under each family of its finishes.

FilterCounts.description:
How many active products each filter value would show together with the other filters of the
query (a value's own filter left out, so the other values of the same menu keep their counts).

swatch.description: One part, or two for a product of two colours or materials, the main one first

FinishResponse.description:
A colour products are sold in, as the shop draws its swatch: the key products, carts and orders
store, the name to show, the family the colour filter counts it under, and one or two parts.

OptionItem.description: Option of a dropdown: the key sent back in queries and the label to show.

slug.description: Stable, address-friendly name; content (collections, lookbooks) refers to products by it.

effectivePrice.description: Price the customer pays (sale price or discounted price, else the list price).

colors.description: The finishes it is sold in, by key (GET /products/finishes), the photographed one first.

availableQuantity.description: Units a new order can get.

ratingAverage.description: Average of the published reviews (1-5), 0 without any.

stockQuantity.description: Units on hand, held ones included; only in the admin responses.

reservedQuantity.description: Units held for orders not shipped yet; only in the admin responses.

images.description: Pictures shown after the main one (image), in order.

ProductDetailResponse.description:
One product as its own page shows it: everything of a catalogue entry plus the gallery and
the points on the main picture. The points are returned as stored; one leading to a product
the catalogue does not list (retired, or not added yet) is for the client to leave out.

ProductHotspotDto.description: A point on the main picture, in percent of its width (x) and height (y), and the product it leads to.

ProductImageDto.description: A gallery picture and what it shows.

slug.description: Stable, address-friendly name; content (collections, lookbooks) refers to products by it.

effectivePrice.description: Price the customer pays (sale price or discounted price, else the list price).

colors.description: The finishes it is sold in, by key (GET /products/finishes), the photographed one first.

availableQuantity.description: Units a new order can get.

ratingAverage.description: Average of the published reviews (1-5), 0 without any.

stockQuantity.description: Units on hand, held ones included; only in the admin responses.

reservedQuantity.description: Units held for orders not shipped yet; only in the admin responses.

totalCount.description: Rows in the whole listing, not on this page.

ProductResponsePagedResponse.description: One page of a listing, the same shape for every resource.

colors.description: Colour variants the product is sold in

effectivePrice.description: The price a customer pays right now (sale price or discounted list price)

isActive.description: False once the product was deleted from the catalogue

updatedAt.description: Last change in the catalogue, for callers that cache

availableQuantity.description: Units a new order can get right now; the reservation after checkout is what counts

ProductSnapshot.description:
What the catalogue tells other services about a product: enough to show a cart line and
to charge the right price. Returned by `GET /api/v1/products/{id}/snapshot`; the caller
stores the fields it needs instead of keeping a copy of the product.

correction.description: The search the results are for, when the typed one found nothing ("sofa" for "sfoa"); null otherwise.

products.description: The best matches, the title's words first.

ProductSuggestions.description: What the search box shows while typing: the best matches and the correction of a mistyped search.

colors.description: The colour families; a product is under the families of its finishes (GET /products/finishes).

groupCategoryMap.description: Groups with the categories that belong to them, for dependent dropdowns.

searchCorrection.description: The search the counts are for, when the typed one found nothing and was corrected; null otherwise.

ProductsMeta.description:
The values the catalogue can be filtered by, for the shop's menus and the admin form.
Keys use the same spelling as the product fields ("tvStands", "modenza"); "all" comes
first so a menu can default to it.

SetStockRequest.description: Body of PUT /api/v1/products/{id}/stock: the units on hand after a count.

StockAlertRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/products/{id}/notify: where to write when the product is back.

StockAvailability.description: How a product's availability is shown to customers; the API writes it in camelCase.

traceId.description: W3C trace id of the request, to find it in the logs.

errors.description: Messages per field of a 422 problem.

StoreProblemDetails.description:
The error response as this store fills it, for the document only: the RFC 9457 members
plus the trace id every problem carries and the field messages of a validation problem.

color.description: Its colour (#rrggbb); with a texture, the texture's average, to show while the picture loads

SwatchTexture.description:
The surfaces a swatch shows beside its colour - a wood, a weave, a stone, a metal. Each is a
crop of a product picture (Scripts/swatches.json) the UI draws the swatch with; the API writes
them in camelCase.

colors.description: The finishes it is sold in, by key (GET /products/finishes), the photographed one first.

groups.description: Replaces the whole list when present; an empty list removes every group.

materials.description: Replaces the whole list when present; an empty list removes every material.

images.description: Replaces the gallery when present; an empty list leaves the main picture only.

hotspots.description: Replaces the points on the main picture when present; an empty list removes them all.

isActive.description: False hides the product from the public catalogue, true brings a deleted one back.

UpdateProductRequest.description:
Body of PUT /api/v1/products/{id}: a partial update. A property that is absent keeps the
current value. Fields that can be empty use Store.BuildingBlocks.Api.Optional`1, so sending them as
null clears them - that is how a promotion is taken off a product.
Rules: `UpdateProductRequestValidator`.

Bearer.description: Access token issued by the identity service

tags.name: Products
tags.description:
The catalogue. Reads are public and show active products only; writes need the true
administrator. Errors arrive as problem responses from the shared exception handler.
